jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Agentic Membership Experiences (Amex Digital Labs)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Amex Digital Labs is responsible for catalyzing digital innovation at American Express by originating, incubating, and managing emerging products and platforms that can be essential to our customers’ digital lives. We emphasize creativity, customer centricity, and innovation. Focus areas include crafting industry-leading digital payment solutions, using our servicing network and lifestyle assets to build digital experiences, and defining new products and services based on emerging technologies and trends.

Role Overview

Amex Digital Labs is hiring a Product Director to lead the strategy and development of new products that create value for Card Members and broaden what American Express Membership makes possible. They will identify Card Member needs and opportunities where advances in agentic AI can unlock entirely new products and experiences. They will draw on American Express’s membership and lifestyle assets to turn the strongest opportunities into differentiated products. The work could range from transforming how Card Members plan and experience trips to helping them discover events, entertainment, and things to do.

This role requires a seasoned product leader and builder with the judgment to turn ambiguous customer needs into clear product bets, guide 0 to 1 development, and scale the strongest products and underlying capabilities. They will bring hands-on fluency with agentic AI-- enough to prototype, assess feasibility and tradeoffs, and shape products alongside design and engineering. They must also lead and develop a high-performing team, align partners across American Express, and work effectively with external partners.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Sense, and Vision

Define a product vision grounded in what Card Members need, value, and trust.
Identify where agentic AI can create meaningful value in Card Members’ lives.
Translate human-centered insights, data, and emerging technologies into clear product opportunities.
Develop a strong point of view on how new experiences should work, feel, and create value for Card Members.
Build and prioritize a portfolio of 0 to 1 opportunities, deciding where to experiment, invest, scale, or stop.

Product Development and Delivery

Lead products from customer insight and early concept through prototype, pilot, launch, and scale.
Prototype and pressure-test ideas early to test assumptions, learn with customers, and refine the product direction.
Work hands-on with design, engineering, and data science to make new ideas tangible.
Hold a high bar for product quality, craft, and customer experience while maintaining pace.
Build experiences that make advanced technology feel simple, intuitive, and trustworthy.

Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Influence

Lead and develop a high-performing product team with clarity, empathy, and strong product judgment.
Align teams around a shared direction without losing the point of view that makes the product distinctive.
Bring together design, engineering, data, risk, and business partners to create cohesive customer experiences.
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, thoughtful critique, and continuous learning.
Influence senior leaders and mobilize stakeholders across a complex enterprise.

Qualifications

8+ years of progressive product management experience, including significant ownership of customer-facing digital products, new product development, or emerging-technology initiatives.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing product managers and building high-performing teams.
Proven track record of taking 0 to 1 products from customer insight and concept development through launch, iteration, and scale.
Strong product sense and experience applying human-centered design, customer research, data, and experimentation to make high-quality decisions.
Technical fluency in generative AI, agentic AI, LLMs, APIs, and platforms, with experience working hands-on with design and engineering to prototype ideas and evaluate tradeoffs.
Experience defining product strategy and managing a portfolio of opportunities at different stages of maturity.
Proven ability to operate in complex, highly regulated environments and align stakeholders across product, design, engineering, data, risk, legal, privacy, compliance, and information security.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and translate complex technologies into clear customer and business outcomes.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

The Director of Product Development will lead the innovation and commercialization process for a growing personal care and home cleaning brand. This role is responsible for bringing new products to market from concept through launch while ensuring alignment with consumer trends, brand positioning, regulatory standards, operational capabilities, and business objectives. The ideal candidate combines strong project management skills with a passion for innovation, formulation trends, sustainability, and consumer-driven product development.

Lead the development pipeline for new personal care and home cleaning products, identifying whitespace opportunities, consumer needs, and emerging industry trends.

Partner closely with marketing, operations, sourcing, supply chain, regulatory, quality, and sales teams to ensure successful product launches and ongoing product improvements.

Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We’re succeeding because they’re succeeding.

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we’re on a quest to change banking for good.

We’re currently seeking a Senior Manager, Product Design to join our Experience Design organization.

The Experience Design team at Capital One is at the forefront of enriching our customers’ digital and physical experiences and we are passionate about creating memorable, meaningful product experiences that build the Capital One brand with humanity and drive business advantage and innovation. We champion a thriving environment of collaboration, authenticity and healthy critique, in which we honor diversity of thought, create a culture of belonging, and elevate one another. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Expectations

As a Senior Manager of Product Design, you’ll combine your craft expertise and people leadership skills with an understanding of our customers and the business to co-create innovative solutions to complex problems, drive product strategy and create a thriving team culture of high performing designers.

Here are some of the expected competencies for this role:

Product Design Expertise: Demonstrate established expertise in product design, leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and work with your team to develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high-fidelity designs and prototypes

Leadership: Reinforce a positive and inclusive team environment, set goals aligned to broader portfolio strategy, manage stakeholders, remove barriers and train and develop designers who are empowered to reach their potential and enabled to help the business to achieve its goals

Strategic Direction: You'll shape product direction and outcomes by leveraging deep design expertise, user insights, and an understanding of the business. You'll drive alignment across product, tech, and business partners, ensuring user needs are central to our overall strategy and enabling bold, innovative solutions to complex problems.

Human-Centered: Advocate for human-centered methodologies that align customer needs and business goals by applying data, research insights, design expertise and a mature perspective to problem-solving across the portfolio.

Business-Focused: Demonstrate strong knowledge of products, processes, customers, competitors and broader market trends and use that knowledge to shape how Design should engage (i.e., actively managing the portfolio, pivoting, redirecting and broadening and narrowing scope, as needed)

Problem-Solving: Own the problem-solving approach (issue, impact, resolution) and apply good judgment when exploring alternatives and balancing competing interests or priorities, leveraging leadership for input and alignment. Bring exceptional creativity to exploring a solution space.

Collaboration: Engage partner expertise and perspectives from across the organization to support workstream projects and identify the people needed to move the work forward, embracing compromise to solve strategic challenges and deliver the best results

Communication: Present work across levels and job functions, modeling a strategic human-centered approach that integrates design frameworks, data and research insights to make the complex accessible, influence stakeholders and achieve desired results

The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating your leadership, process, results and impact.

At least 6 years of experience in design and prototyping tools such as Figma
At least 2 years of experience in a people leadership role

Experience working with and contributing to an established design system
Experience collaborating with product, tech and business leaders

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the Chief Product & Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

The Chief of Staff to the Chief Product & Technology Officer
will serve as a strategic advisor and execution partner to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, helping translate the organization’s most critical, strategic, complex, and high-risk enterprise and Product & Technology priorities into clear decisions, coordinated action, and measurable outcomes.

This role will operate across the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s portfolio and the Executive Leadership Team, connecting Product, Technology, Media Technology and Operations, Product and Information, Advertising Product, and other corporate and business stakeholders.

The Chief of Staff will create the operating mechanisms that keep priorities visible, decisions moving, risks surfaced, and leaders accountable for follow-through, while leading cross-functional initiatives that span organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority.

Success will be measured by the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s ability to focus on the highest-value enterprise priorities; the clarity and effectiveness of the organization’s operating cadence; the speed and quality of cross-functional decisions; and the consistent execution of strategic initiatives across the Product & Technology portfolio.

What You’ll Do

Executive Strategy and Decision Support

Serve as a recognized internal and external expert in executive operations, enterprise strategy, and organizational effectiveness, bringing authoritative perspective to the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior leaders.
Determine and introduce leading-edge business, operating, and decision-making approaches that improve how the Product & Technology portfolio sets direction and executes against strategic objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, providing objective analysis, recommendations, and a proactive view of risks, opportunities, and organizational dynamics.
Help define, prioritize, and communicate the Product & Technology portfolio’s most important enterprise priorities and strategic outcomes.
Prepare executive briefings, decision memos, talking points, presentations, and other materials for ELT meetings, leadership reviews, board-related moments, and critical internal communications.
Distill complex business, product, technology, operational, and financial information into clear choices, tradeoffs, and recommended actions.
Anticipate information and decisions the Chief Product & Technology Officer will need and coordinate the right people, data, and analysis to support timely resolution.
Operate with discretion and sound judgment, managing sensitive matters, stakeholder dynamics, and critical escalations professionally.

Portfolio Operating Cadence and Governance

Design and manage the operating cadence for the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s organization, including leadership staff meetings, operating reviews, strategic planning, portfolio reviews, and follow-up mechanisms.
Establish clear governance practices for cross-functional decisions, escalations, dependencies, and risk management across the Product & Technology portfolio
Maintain a single source of truth for enterprise priorities, milestones, decisions, dependencies, risks, and accountability.
Aggregate and synthesize performance updates, operating metrics, and strategic progress for the Chief Product & Technology Officer and the ELT.
Identify gaps in reporting, metrics, or operating mechanisms and implement improvements that increase transparency, speed, and accountability.
Track decisions and commitments through completion, escalating risks early with options and recommendations.

Cross-Functional Strategic Initiatives

Lead the most critical, strategic, complex, and high-risk enterprise initiatives on behalf of the Chief Product & Technology Officer from problem definition through implementation and measurable results.
Coordinate work across Product, Engineering, Technology Operations, Media Technology and Operations, Advertising Product, Finance, Legal, People & Culture, Security, and other stakeholders as needed.
Translate strategic priorities into integrated plans with clear owners, milestones, decision points, measures of success, and communication requirements.
Surface cross-portfolio tradeoffs and help leaders align on sequencing, resource allocation, scope, and risk.
Facilitate resolution of issues that span multiple functions, organizations, or executive stakeholders.
Drive organizational transformation, process improvement, and new ways of working that strengthen execution at scale.

Executive Communications and Alignment

Develop clear narratives and communications that connect the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s priorities to company strategy, business outcomes, team member impact, and customer value.
Support ELT, Product & Technology leadership, all-hands, offsite, and other executive forums with agendas, content, preparation, and follow-through.
Ensure decisions and priorities are communicated consistently across leadership teams and translated into actionable direction.
Serve as a connective point across the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s direct leadership team and key enterprise partners, while maintaining appropriate ownership with the accountable leaders.
Represent the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s priorities and direction in cross-functional forums when appropriate, using sound judgment and discretion
Consolidate, refine, or craft high-quality materials for executive, board, internal, investor, and other external interactions – e.g., presentations, memos, speeches. Also coordinate and assist with meeting prep or speaking rehearsals as needed.

Organizational Effectiveness and Confidential Support

Guide and mentor a wide range of leaders and stakeholders, using influence and expertise to strengthen decision quality, enterprise execution, and organizational effectiveness.
Partner with the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership alignment, team dynamics, and decision quality.
Handle confidential business, personnel, financial, product, technology, and organizational information with a high degree of discretion and integrity.
Help clarify roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across a complex, matrixed organization.
Build trusted relationships across the organization and create effective networks that enable progress without direct authority.

What You’ll Need

Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 10 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience
Demonstrated experience serving as a Chief of Staff to a senior Technology leader, partnering with C-suite, ELT, and other senior executives to drive strategic priorities and enterprise-wide execution.
Proven ability to lead complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact.
Strong understanding of business operations, strategy, finance, product, technology, or another complex, matrixed business environment.
Experience in Product, Technology, Engineering, or another complex technology-enabled business.
Experience designing operating cadences, governance mechanisms, decision frameworks, performance reporting, or portfolio management practices.
Exceptional ability to analyze complex information, develop options, assess tradeoffs, and make pragmatic recommendations under tight timelines.
Strong program and portfolio management skills, including the ability to manage dependencies, risks, milestones, and executive-level reporting.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex topics into crisp narratives, executive briefings, and decision memos. Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and levels without direct authority and align diverse stakeholders around a common direction.
Sound judgment, executive presence, and the ability to operate effectively with confidential and highly sensitive information.
Ability to manage multiple priorities with urgency, structure, and sound judgment
High level of integrity, discretion, collaboration, and accountability
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $190,000 to $267,900, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Overview

As VP Product, Interoperability, you will own and execute Cotiviti’s market strategy, product roadmap and commercial growth for health plan interoperability — extending our leading industry position and expanding our impact into broader payer / provider collaboration. You will bring unique insight into payer priorities, challenges, and blind spots; prioritize market needs; run competitive analysis; engage experts within and outside our organization; and lead product launches that expand our client value proposition and advance Cotiviti’s market position. Hands-on knowledge of payer administrative processes and payer / provider interoperability is essential, along with a genuine passion for solving hard problems and improving the healthcare system.

Reporting to the SVP of Product, you will have full ownership and accountability for product vision, definition, packaging, and market success across Cotiviti’s interoperability platform and commercial solutions. You will lead a matrixed, multi-level team, prioritizing and enhancing our existing solutions while delivering next-generation payer / provider collaboration solutions. You will bridge product vision, operational design, and commercial success — defining Cotiviti’s approach across the product lines you support. You will advocate and solution to ensure that all Cotiviti’s product offerings are FHIR native and leveraging our Interoperability Platform[CC1.1].

Cotiviti is evolving our market approach to become the utility layer for healthcare—reducing friction and significantly improving coordination across the system. In this role, you will play a key role in defining and executing Cotiviti’s expanded vision and improving healthcare. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a leader who combines deep product and market domain expertise, healthcare knowledge, business acumen, creativity, sound business judgment, and sharp analytical thinking.

Responsibilities

You will lead a cross-sectional, matrixed team, driving a customer- and sales-focused approach to building and launching new products, capabilities, and offerings into the marketplace. Here’s what you’ll own:

Vision

Leverage deep subject matter expertise to provide input into Cotiviti’s strategic plan across business units.
Collaborate with executive leadership to develop targets for annual bookings, revenue, expenses, and client satisfaction.
Serve as a voice of the customer in new product management and development.

Strategic & Product Leadership

Develop multi-year roadmaps that provide deep insight into how we can become integral to the payer/provider collaboration journey, from provider workflows through post-adjudication.
Provide executive leadership for Cotiviti’s interoperability business, including product strategy, market strategy, operational strategy, revenue growth, client outcomes, and long-term business expansion.
Develop and influence corporate strategy related to interoperability, provider connectivity, healthcare data exchange, and payer-provider collaboration.
Serve as Cotiviti’s executive representative with key clients, strategic partners, regulators, industry consortiums, and market influencers.

Operational & Technical Leadership

Provide unique insight into the internal mechanics and challenges of payer platforms, processes, and administrative inefficiency, as well as payer/provider interoperability.

Process Improvement

Drive process re-engineering efforts leveraging AI and emerging technologies to drive transformative changes and improve the system.

Financial & Risk

Provide knowledge of how payers identify and eliminate administrative waste in claims processing, prior authorization, and other core operational processes through advanced data analytics tools, including areas of strength and gaps.
Leverage expertise in how payers currently perceive and manage costs with siloed or competitive approaches.
Own business performance, revenue growth, operating margin achievement, investment prioritization, and long-range financial planning for the interoperability business.

Compliance & Legal Oversight

Act as an authority for ensuring all products and operational workflows adhere to state and federal regulations.

Product Management

Lead a multidisciplinary organization through Directors, Senior Directors, and other senior leaders responsible for Product Management, Product Operations, Market Strategy, and Product Commercialization.
Lead cross-functional teams across Product, Marketing, Sales, Business Unit Operations, and R&D to develop and launch enhancements to the solutions portfolio.
Align with Business Unit and R&D processes, including SAFe Agile, as well as Product Management teams for delivering capabilities.
Define success criteria, review product performance against expectations, and facilitate or influence changes to the product portfolio to improve competitive position and optimize product performance.

Go to Market

Own the definition of customer experience for end-to-end solutions.
Lead completion and upkeep of Ready to Market (R2M) and Ready to Sell (R2S) tools, content, and training.

Team Leadership

Collaborate with the Product leadership team to establish and continuously improve processes for Product Management.
Assist Business Unit leaders in defining core processes and staffing needs to support new solutions .

Coaching

Champion the discipline of product development and product management practices, ensuring teams have the essential tools, processes, and skill sets to build product and service roadmaps that align with Cotiviti’s strategic and operational plans.

Growth

Define and execute three-to-five-year growth strategies, including market expansion, partnership strategies, acquisition integration opportunities, and innovation investments.
Be accountable for developing solutions that support profitability, efficiency, and growth targets.
Lead others in the design and development of new products.
Ask effective questions to fully understand client needs and engage others to solve those challenges. Assist in developing pricing strategies to maximize overall returns.

Quality

Work closely with technology, operations, and senior leadership to ensure releases are of the highest quality and the team can demonstrate progress against quality goals through clear metrics.
Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that employs best-in-class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal-setting process.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience required ; Master of Business Administration degree preferred.
1 0 to 15+ years of progressive insurance and product experience, with a minimum of eight years in senior leadership roles overseeing matrixed teams.
10+ years of experience, with increasing levels of responsibility and oversight, managing Product, Operations, or Professional Services.
10+ years of experience preferred in the healthcare industry, with previous leadership experience in the appropriate domain , strong personnel management and presentation skills, and customer (internal/external) problem diagnostics and solution design capabilities.
Deep subject matter expertise in payer/provider interoperability and claims processing operations; direct experience managing claims operations or payer/provider interoperability for a health plan strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of standards, the regulatory environment, and compliance considerations for interoperability required . Ability to measure and articulate the business value of compliance preferred.
Advanced knowledge of claims management ecosystems and the ability to align R&D processes, such as SAFe Agile, with core operational needs.
Proactive leader with proven experience in strategic and tactical leadership and the ability to pursue and understand cutting-edge technologies.
The intellect and energy to excel in a complex and ever-changing environment, coupled with the poise and ability to act calmly in high-pressure, high-stress situations.
Proven experience in growth-oriented businesses in the healthcare information and analytics space, with strong competencies in developing and leading product development and strategy.
Excellent coach who is results-oriented and can build and motivate high-performance teams.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

Problem-solving and thinking critically.
Completing tasks independently.

Physical Requirements And Working Conditions

Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

This position drives the overall product strategy and execution, ensuring alignment with business goals and effective communication across teams. The Principal Product Manager owns the full product lifecycle for a specific product, from ideation to market launch and continuous optimization. This role plays a pivotal part in defining the product strategy, ensuring that it aligns with the company’s long-term goals, and works closely with cross-functional teams to execute the roadmap.

Customer and Market-Driven Strategy

Lead customer and market research efforts to inform product strategy, ensuring customer pain points and market trends drive decision-making while optimizing product profitability and return on investment.

Stakeholder Alignment and Influence

Influence product decisions by aligning engineering, marketing, and leadership teams, ensuring strategic cohesion across all functions. Shape internal and external messaging to ensure product initiatives align with business objectives and customer needs.

Problem Solving/Autonomy

Tackle ambiguous, large-scale problems and drive resolution with minimal oversight.

Data-Driven Decision Making

Make high-level decisions based on data, balancing customer insights with business needs and performance metrics to guide product direction.

Domain Knowledge

Have a deep, nuanced understanding of the product and market landscape.

Leadership and Team Management

Lead the full matrixed team for your product, making key decisions, guiding team efforts, and driving product direction. Mentor junior team members.

Own the tactical execution of the product strategy for your product, ensuring alignment with company objectives. Guide and make high-level decisions that shape the product’s future.

Identify opportunities for end-to-end solutions by integration and/or APIs between solutions and recommend harmonizing and standardizing roadmaps.
Participate as a trusted advisor to the suite owner to assist in the definition of individual solutions and their evolution.
Enable and advance Vertex innovation capability and speed by leveraging and exposing industry knowledge and experience.
Interface/Team across functional areas such as Strategy and Emerging Technology to create long-term product vision and concepts.
Participate in setting the mid-term strategic and product direction for Vertex.
Maintain frequent contact with customers, partners, and other market participants to identify pain points and derive innovation ideas.
Present and represent Vertex in conferences to showcase Vertex thought leadership.

Ability to articulate and translate business problems into solutions in a cloud environment.

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

Frontline's software products are live, in use, and improving - and the opportunity ahead is to take them significantly further. The right person here is a builder at heart: someone who can absorb what exists, bring structure and rigor to how it evolves, and drive the roadmap that connects a proven hardware system to a world-class software experience. You'll be extending a foundation that already has real traction, with the latitude to shape how the entire software function operates as the company scales.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Roadmap

Own the software roadmap across apps, web, fleet and installer tools, internal tools, and data products
Translate customer, installer, support, and business needs into clear requirements and PRDs
Prioritize across revenue, customer experience, reliability, install scale, and support burden
Build lightweight prototypes and MVPs to validate ideas before build

Program Execution

Lead cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch, owning scope, milestones, and risks
Coordinate with software, firmware, hardware, and data teams to ensure data flow
Establish simple rhythms for roadmap, release planning, and post-launch learning, and CI/CD pipeline management

Team & Process

Grow and mentor the software product and function as the team scales
Stand up key software product processes: development lifecycle, requirements, and release management

Qualifications

Must-Have:

7+ years in software product, technical product, or program management
Track record delivering complex software products from concept through launch
Technical fluency across mobile/web apps, backend, APIs, data products, and cloud software
Experience partnering with engineering to define requirements and ship production software
Systems thinking across software, hardware, field operations, and business strategy
Startup-comfortable: hands-on and self-directed, with excellent communication and prioritization

Nice-to-Have

IoT, connected hardware, smart home, climate tech, or mission-critical products
Mobile app products (iOS/Android and/or React Native)
Geospatial/mapping, telemetry, AI/ML-enabled, or data-platform products

Compensation & Benefits

Company-provided cell phone and laptop

401(k) retirement plan
Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)

Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
And much more!

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Auth0, an Okta company, is an easy to implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.
Our commitment to identity inspires and sustains our Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging strategy as we aim to celebrate and protect the identities of everyone in our network.
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our MFA team who will help secure logins for thousands of customers and millions of people around the world. The MFA team is responsible for the authentication factors — such as WebAuthn, Passkeys, and Passwordless/OTP — to provide the right level of secure access based on business needs.
In this role, you will leverage your technical background, good business sense, and ability to partner closely with engineering, product design, and product marketing teams to shape the product roadmap, deliver high-value solutions, and show measurable outcomes.
This is a high-impact role that requires you to understand the technical aspects of authentication factors, customer use-cases and business challenges across multiple verticals, and how to simplify the experience for end-users who need to authenticate and the development teams that implement identity in their applications.
A fierce curiosity, developer empathy, and strong collaboration skills are your keys to success.

:
Work with engineering and design teams to build actionable requirements and deliver high-value authentication factor solutions
Define and socialize a roadmap that articulates your product direction and strategy
Build compelling business cases to support ongoing product delivery efforts
Become the go-to subject matter expert for your product area

Create assets to guide product development work (framing documents, story maps, opportunity canvases, stories for implementation)

Leverage AI tools throughout the product development cycle — use AI-assisted tools for research, writing, prototyping, and demo creation to move faster, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar at every stage

Strong leadership skills and presence
Technical aptitude and fluency to communicate with engineering teams and customer developers
Track record of successful delivery of technical enterprise products
Excellent communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders
Functional experience in identity management, authentication factors, or security — particularly MFA mechanisms (TOTP, SMS OTP, push notifications, hardware security keys)
Understanding of API and SDK design principles, including developer experience considerations such as error handling, versioning, and documentation
5+ years of experience as a product manager
Champion for collaborative, iterative product discovery
Love the work of identifying and deeply understanding customer problems
Like to get your hands dirty and use the products you build

Familiarity with authentication standards and specifications: WebAuthn, FIDO2/Passkeys, OATH (TOTP/HOTP), OIDC, SAML
Experience with cryptographic concepts relevant to authentication (public key infrastructure, attestation, challenge-response flows)

At Fluxon, we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

Many of our team members call the Bay Area home, but this role is fully remote across North America.

About The Role

You'll act as both a product leader and strategic advisor, partnering closely with clients to shape product direction, navigate complex decisions, manage delivery, and build long-term relationships. As the primary point of contact for your engagements, you'll balance customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, and commercial considerations to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We’re looking for someone who craves having real impact and ownership. While specific responsibilities may differ from project to project, you will:

Develop expertise in a variety of customer domains such as AI, healthcare, SaaS, eCommerce, and many others
Build deep partnerships with startups and tech leaders alike to understand their product, users, and help drive key strategic decisions
Establish a clear product vision and connect the dots across functions and organizations
Communicate roadmaps, decisions, and learnings across a wide range of audiences from development teams to executives
Lead full product and feature development cycles from discovery to delivery

Comfortable engaging with technical concepts and tradeoffs (APIs, data models, system architecture, engineering constraints) well enough to earn credibility with engineering teams and make informed product decisions

Proven ability to thrive within ambiguity by applying a mix of research, analytics, intuition, and empathy to tackle problems
Experience taking multiple products/feature sets through the entire development life cycle, from ideation to launch
Clear and structured communicator, can turn big ideas into actionable roadmaps with clear goals and align multiple levels of stakeholders
Excited about solving complex problems, building innovative products, and learning alongside a world-class team
Demonstrated success managing (executive) client relationships and acting as a trusted advisor throughout complex product engagements.
